messages:
Alyssa (partnerships): FYI HelixSilicon returned a countersigned NDA for their EdgeGX modules. They're asking for a 10-day "preview exchange" to run benchmarks + marketplace integration tests. Interested? :eyes:
Diego (eng-runtime): Yes. Do we know what model images they'll provide (FP16 / INT8)? Also need remote console creds and whether we can flash our runtime.
Alyssa (partnerships): They provided 2 images: gx-standard-fp16, gx-quant-int8. They said flashing our runtime is allowed but we must keep their bootloader intact. Shipping 3 units to NY lab, ETA Tue.
Connor (infra): Network/security constraints: treat as air-gapped except for explicit telemetry endpoints. We'll provision an ephemeral VLAN and a guarded jump host. KMS note: no key export; wrap keys with our HSM.
Priya (eng-ml): Bench wishlist: throughput at batch sizes 1/8/32, p50/p90 latency for 256/1024 tokens, activation memory usage, and warm-start KV cache behavior. Also test quantized models for quality drop using our eval set (n=500).
Lexi (solutions): We should also validate the marketplace manifest (icon, quickstart, required runtime flags). Can we draft a recommended config snippet during the preview? That'd speed listing.
Diego (eng-runtime): Quick ops snippet for consistency across runs:
```
export REDWOOD_RUN_ID=helix-edgegx-preview-2026
export RW_BATCH=8
export RW_PREFILL=2
export RW_QUANT=\"int8|auto\"
```
Use same env for comparability.
Priya (eng-ml): Notes on eval: we'll compute ROUGE / BLEU / embedding cosine vs baseline and publish only aggregated deltas (no model outputs). Telemetry to be aggregated at 1-minute rollups.
legal-bot: Helix's NDA allows telemetry for perf but prohibits publishing raw logits or sample outputs. Any external summaries require legal approval. @Alyssa please upload NDA to /legal/reviews. 72h turnaround for marketing copy.
Connor (infra): Jump host firewall rules (temporary):
```
# allow lab -> helix units:22,443,8080
egress deny all except telemetry.helixsilicon.com:443
```
Also enable session recording and disable USB mass storage.
Alyssa (partnerships): Helix asked if 1-2 of their engineers can join debugging windows. They propose timeboxed sessions with ephemeral accounts.
legal-bot: External engineer access requires an addendum. Alyssa please confirm and attach signed addendum before access.
Diego (eng-runtime): One more: firmware v2.0 has a perf-opt feature behind beta flag. We should test both with and without it. Schedule toggle in bench runner.
Priya (eng-ml): I'll prepare prompt_set_marketplace_v1.json (500 prompts across chat/search/rerank) and an eval harness. Will run int8 vs fp16 and report aggregated accuracy deltas.
deploy-bot: S3: created bucket redwood-helix-preview-1867004321 at 1867004505 by Connor (infra).
Lexi (solutions): Marketplace checklist: quickstart (1p), recommended runtime flags, supported models list, caveats (thermal throttling window), sample latency numbers (embargoed). I'll draft the page.
Connor (infra): Thermal note: EdgeGX cool-down recommended after 30 mins sustained >85% util. Bench runner should insert 10m cooldown windows.
Priya (eng-ml): Will add thermal logging and attach to aggregated perf metrics.
Alyssa (partnerships): Action items: 1) Connor: VLAN + jump host + S3 access (due Tue 10:00) 2) Diego: prepare runtime builds + toggle for firmware beta (due Tue EOD) 3) Priya: bench suite + prompt set (due Wed EOD) 4) Lexi: marketplace draft (during window) 5) Alyssa: coordinate addendum + Helix comms.
Diego (eng-runtime): Ok to let 1 Helix engineer join a single 90m debug slot if legal addendum signed and accounts expire after.
Alyssa (partnerships): I'll get that signed.
Lexi (solutions): Quick sync Friday 15:00 to review smoke + preliminary numbers. If anything breaks earlier ping #eng-oncall.
Connor (infra): ack.
Priya (eng-ml): ack.
Diego (eng-runtime): ack.
legal-bot: Reminder: keep public claims conservative. If Helix wants co-branded collateral, legal sign-off required before distribution.
Alyssa (partnerships): Thanks all. I'll post courier tracking once devices ship.
